scope: 23 fr namespace file(s) at the composed head; every French value added or changed by the batch (471 values) read against the English source and the English context sidecar; the full namespace key sets checked for coverage and orphan keys.
method: Read all scoped fr values with their en source and, where present, the en context sidecar (role/tone/length/note).
Byte-compared en and fr values; every exact match among the batch's values classified as a token/cognate IDENTICAL_OK candidate with a reason, or as a stub. Stubs: 0.
Extracted interpolation arguments with a regex restricted to `{name}` / `{name, type, ...}` nodes (not branch labels) and compared en↔fr per key.
Parsed each `plural` block at brace depth 0 to read its CLDR categories; checked `other` presence and rejected `few`/`two`/`zero` for fr.

Typographic scan outside ICU braces: ASCII space before : ; ! ?, NBSP before punctuation, missing space before ? ! : ;, ASCII ellipsis, straight apostrophes, « » spacing; NFC; bidi control characters.
Register scan for tu/te/ton/ta/tes/toi and for « Veuillez ».
Coverage: en keys missing from fr, and fr keys absent from en, per namespace.

Read the call sites for every value whose meaning, gender or referent depended on context (image/variables previews, inline-edit status, analytics window guards, hub kind noun, credential toast, loader notice).

identical_summary.note: Counts only exact matches among the batch's own values (not pre-existing keys): there are none — all 471 values differ from their English source, so no IDENTICAL_OK entry is proposed for this batch.

verdict: passed — 0 blocker, 0 major, 6 minor, 4 nit across 23 namespace(s); 471 values read; 0 exact matches classified, 0 untranslated stubs.
observations: Prior dispositions not re-opened, with the reason read from the receipts: ui.settings.shortcuts.row.canvas and .row.console stay lowercase (« canvas », « console ») because the capitalised forms are byte-identical to en and the no-stub guard rejects them without an IDENTICAL_OK entry (FR-SURF-m3/m4, FR2-SHORTCUT-FIT); ui.hub.updates.kind.agent stays « Agent » for the same guard reason (FR2-HUB-CASE, status not applied); ui.settings.shortcuts.row.execution's rendered fit is still unmeasured (FR-SURF-i3). These are gate/test-lane decisions, not translation defects I re-report.
This head has 0 exact matches to English in the 471 batch values: every value differs from its source. Coverage is complete (471/471 in the 23 namespaces; 0 missing, 0 orphan).

Prior remediation: the surfaces lane's remediation round 2 (12e143d5, 29 changed values in 8 namespaces) is inside the audited head. Because the manager asked for a batch audit, I read the composed head rather than only that 29-value delta; the prior rounds' fixed keys are unchanged.

Shared namespaces: ui.common.actions (6 shared keys), ui.common.updates (127), ui.common.viewer (4) and ui.common.speech (0) also carry canvas-batch keys (PR #1388), with 0 value conflicts; a hand-union is safe but the merged bytes will differ from both heads, so the ledger must bind post-merge hashes for those namespaces (see the canvas receipt's observation).

Terminology left as an observation, not a finding: « asset » is « ressource » in ui.library.errors.asset_read (this batch) and « Élément » in ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.asset_of (canvas batch, PR #1388). They are different surfaces and different batches, so no single receipt should force one; the merge owner should either settle one term or record the split as deliberate.

Not a translation finding (code scope): hub-update-mark.tsx builds its aria-labels as English template literals around the localized HUB_KIND_NOUN (« Update all ${available} ${noun} updates from the hub »), so the localized noun never reaches a screen reader today.

Typographic and structural checks found no defects: 0 straight apostrophes outside CLI/JSON literals, 0 ASCII ellipses, U+202F before every prose : ; ! ?, « » with U+202F inside, no NBSP, NFC-clean, 0 bidi controls; 11 plural blocks in the batch, every one carrying one/many/other with `other` and no few/two/zero (the only `=0` arm is the English-mirrored one in session_report_model.totals_meta).

Width: no fr key in this batch declares a `maxCells` budget in its context sidecar. 75 values are ≥1.35× their English source on sources of 40 characters or fewer — again mostly wrapping sentences and status lines (« Application de bureau » for « Desktop », « Détails d’exécution » for « Run details », « Demandes » for « Asks »). The one fixed-row label worth a rendered frame is ui.settings.shortcuts.row.execution (11→19 characters), which is the prior round's still-open FR-SURF-i3 item; it is recorded there, not as a new finding.

The prior surfaces round localized « Entrée »/« Maj » but did not settle « Esc ».

French needs the scope named; « hors du navigateur » keeps the English meaning and the sentence grammatical.
